author: Ifmyante
text:
The 3Drive onto S/D can be a strong indication that price will turn.

It shows that price advances are slowing down, while compressing up/down, taking out orders as it goes.

author: Josh
text:
Would you class this as a 3Drive pattern?

Where did you get the name for this by the way? I think I understand what you're looking for behind the pattern but wanted to check it is what I'm thinking.

author: Ifmyante
text:
Yup. That's a 3drive. I really don't know where the term comes from, but the CP in it and the psychology behind it make alot of sense. It's quite a common pattern, and provides very low risk setups.

I know I ask people to look for patterns - this is to get a concrete starting point in learning to read price. Once folk start to seek out these patterns, they'll begin to notice a myriad other phenomena, which will become very important EUREKA moments for them - I just love those EUREKA moments:cheer:
